record.question: City of Golden Gate
record.explanation: Answer D: San Francisco. San Francisco is the city associated with the Golden Gate. The Huntington’s primary custody catalogue holds Samuel Williams’s The City of the Golden Gate:A Description of San Francisco in 1875, published in 1921; the title directly establishes the historical association among these choices. Historical/source note: Historical geographical nickname. It refers to the Golden Gate strait/city association and predates the 1937 bridge. Reference: https://www.huntington.org/collections/lib-74606. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
